title: CITIZENS FINANCIAL GROUP INC/RI 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Citizens Financial Group filed an 8-K reporting results from its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on April 23, 2026. All director nominees were elected for one-year terms expiring at the 2027 Annual Meeting. Advisory vote on executive compensation was approved, and Deloitte & Touche LLP was ratified as the independent accounting firm for 2026. A shareholder proposal to adopt a majority voting standard was not approved.
key_points: Citizens Financial Group held its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on April 23, 2026
All director nominees were elected; Edward J. Kelly III received the highest against votes (16,011,559) and Bruce Van Saun received the most against votes (20,362,054)
Advisory vote on executive compensation approved with 327,158,449 votes for and 30,630,016 votes against
Deloitte & Touche LLP ratified as registered independent public accounting firm for 2026 with 355,450,674 votes for
Shareholder proposal for majority voting standard rejected with 321,379,352 votes against and 36,243,037 votes for
There were 26,316,510 broker non-votes for proposals 1, 2, and 4
why_it_matters: This filing reports routine corporate governance outcomes for Citizens Financial Group (CFG), a regional bank holding company. The voting results have no material relevance to macro market catalysts or market structure. Director election outcomes and the failed majority voting proposal are internal governance matters with no broader market implications.
